main_text.p: gumentum fit, nec cuivis concef-fum, ut ea de re iuftum iudicium ferat: illud tantum in medium af-feram, eam tibi, Nobiliffime Domine, in primis neceffariam effe. Nam ficuti regiones, quæ ad Rhenum fitæ funt Gallica magis delectantur, necessitate quadam compulsi, propter commercia quæ cum vicinis Gallis exercent: ita Germaniæ populi auolæ Danubij eandem ob causam, quòd cum finitimis Italis negotia gerant. Italicæ quoque linguæ addicti magis effe leguntur, quàm Gallicæ. Huc adde, quod rei caput est, cum in aula Cæsarea nulla alia lingua inter aulicos magis in usu (de peregrinis loquor) quàm Italica sit, Túque ex vere generosa antiquissimáque inter Moravos familia ortum ducas,

page.notes: Running head and text reproduced as printed; the first line of text is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Some letters in "concef-fum" and "Túque" are doubtful in the scan; "Túque" may be a printing or scan artefact. No catchword or signature visible.
